section_summary: This section closes correspondence about a Parker Pen Company case and includes a rejection notice for a Japanese fountain pen patent application. It then reproduces Lucius A. Crowell’s U.S. patent for a pen barrel with alternating transparent and opaque zones, followed by a list of Japanese manufacturers alleged to make infringing pens and an Ishii Seisakujo advertisement. The final page is a file note pointing to a separate 1933 memorandum about Prophylactic Toothbrush Company rights.

subfiles.title: Closing page of letter concerning The Parker Pen Company
subfiles.about: The writer asks to be advised that the Parker Pen Company case has been amended.
subfiles.summary: Closing request for confirmation that the case has been amended.

subfiles.title: Exhibit B-8: Rejection Notice, Application No. 12149 of 1933
subfiles.about: The patent bureau rejects a fountain pen barrel application as lacking a patentable invention.
subfiles.summary: The notice upholds an earlier rejection, finding that opaque scale-like zones on a transparent barrel would be obvious to skilled makers.

subfiles.title: U.S. Patent 1,989,351: Fountain Pen and Other Marking Means
subfiles.about: Crowell patents a fountain pen whose alternating transparent and non-transparent zones show ink level in transmitted light while preserving a uniform exterior.
subfiles.summary: The patent includes a cover label, two drawing sheets, a specification, and fourteen claims. Crowell describes barrels made with alternating transparent and non-transparent rings, spirals, or longitudinal bands. Matching opaque zones on the pen section and caps give the filled pen a uniform appearance in reflected light, while transmitted light reveals the ink level. The patent names Crowell as inventor and The Parker Pen Company as assignee.

subfiles.title: Names and Addresses of Japanese Manufacturers of Infringing Structures
subfiles.about: The list identifies Japanese pen makers alleged to manufacture infringing structures and cites reports or enclosed advertising.
subfiles.summary: Lists seven firms, addresses, and supporting reports, including allegations of a Parker Vacumatic imitation.

subfiles.title: Ishii’s Fountain Pen Advertisement
subfiles.about: Ishii Seisakujo advertises fountain pens, materials, prices, and its Tokyo sales and factory addresses.
subfiles.summary: Promotes Ishii fountain pens and offers a sample assortment for 10 yen.

subfiles.title: Document File Note: Prophylactic Toothbrush Company
subfiles.about: The note directs readers to an August 23, 1933 memorandum on alleged violations of Prophylactic Toothbrush Company rights.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to a memorandum on Japanese violations of the company’s trademark and patent rights.
